shortDescription: Allows operations with IONOS CLOUD Mongo Clusters.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: The ID of the backup to be used.

options.name: connections
options.description: Array of datacenters to connect to your cluster.

options.name: instances
options.description: The total number of instances in the cluster (one primary and n-1 secondaries).

options.name: location
options.description: The physical location where the cluster will be created. This is the location where all your instances will be located. This property is immutable.

options.name: maintenance_window
options.description: A weekly window of 4 hours during which maintenance work can be performed.

options.name: mongo_cluster
options.description: The ID or name of an existing Mongo Cluster.

options.name: mongo_db_version
options.description: The MongoDB version of your cluster.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: template_id
options.description: The unique ID of the template, which specifies the number of cores, storage size, and memory. You cannot downgrade to a smaller template or minor edition; for example, downgrading from *Business* to *Playground* is not possible. To get a list of all templates to confirm the changes, use the '/templates' endpoint.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
